title: Octahedron
text:
An octahedron is a three-dimensional geometric shape with eight flat faces. In standard geometry, when people refer to an octahedron, they usually mean a regular octahedron, which is one of the five Platonic solids.

In a regular octahedron, all eight faces are identical equilateral triangles. It has six vertices and twelve edges, with four triangular faces meeting at every single vertex.

To visualize its structure, you can think of it as two square-based pyramids connected directly together at their square bases. Because of its symmetrical properties, it acts as the geometric dual of the cube—meaning if you place a point at the center of every face of a cube and connect them, you form a regular octahedron. -twilight
